<reason>A more convincingly established the mismatch between harmful amplification and a political-topic gate. B offered meaningful autonomy and auditability arguments, but did not adequately weigh them against lost civic discovery. Its one-click response assumed the awareness recommendations might create, while its claim that reweighted rankings necessarily preserve radicalization was asserted rather than established. A answered both pressure questions directly and used B’s concessions to sharpen the case against the proposed default.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s worker-safety question forced B to defend gating a reform appeal while allowing the underlying grievance. A’s response—that grievances can be furious and proposed remedies calm—directly undermined B’s claim that this political boundary tracks outrage rather than merely subject matter.</best_rebuttal>
